title: The action integrand of an integer multiplicity triple is integrable
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep in U (IMRep U n). In particular: M = R.carrier is a Borel set with M ⊆ U; θ = R.mult : ℝ^P → ℕ is measurable; ∫_{M∩K} θ dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U (field locallyIntegrable_mult); ξ = R.orient : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) = MultiVector P n (continuous linear functionals on n-covectors, operator norm) is a.e. strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞M; and for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x there is a subspace Q with IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ x) Q (field orients). Here Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Let ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n: a C^∞ n-form on ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport ω ⊆ U). Then the function x ↦ θ(x)·⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ = (R.mult x : ℝ) · R.orient x (ω x) is integrable with respect to Hⁿ⌞M = μHE[n].restrict R.carrier.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Integrable (fun x => (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)) (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier)
